import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, order=bmi_order, palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14)
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
